cli.help:
Arcana World — Bilibili live console / Bubble Tea

Usage: arcana-world [options]

Explicit proxy, OBS auto-connect/auto-stream and TTS overrides apply only to this run, are not saved, and cannot be changed in the interface.

Drag within chat, history, log, or notification body text to select; y copies, Esc clears. Ctrl+C opens quit confirmation.
